_comment: Job sources. Everything here is free. Keys marked (optional) need a free API key stored as a GitHub secret - see README.

jooble._comment: Free aggregator API (Bayt, GulfTalent, Naukrigulf, Indeed...). Key = secret JOOBLE_API_KEY. Keys have a request quota (default 500), so queries/pages are kept small: requests per run = len(queries) x countries x pages. 'countries' limits which profile countries are queried (this key's coverage is strong for Canada, weak for the GCC).

google_alerts_rss._comment: Optional. Create Google Alerts (https://www.google.com/alerts) delivered as RSS feed and paste the feed URLs here. Free catch-all for LinkedIn/Bayt/company postings Google indexes.

gulftalent._comment: Best effort HTML. Blocked from some datacenter IPs (403); skipped automatically when blocked.

linkedin_guest._comment: Best effort. LinkedIn's public guest listing endpoint; frequently rate-limited. Skipped automatically on challenge.

workday._comment: Employer career sites on Workday. tenant / host / site verified from the employer's careers URL: https://<tenant>.<host>.myworkdayjobs.com/<site>

successfactors._comment: SAP SuccessFactors career sites (search page HTML). base = site root, slug = path segment.

workable._comment: Workable accounts (apply.workable.com/<account>). Rate-limited; the agent backs off.
